snippet.title: 경상북도 "햇살 에너지 농사 지으세요"⋯태양광 설비에 저리 융자 지원 #shorts (대구MBC)
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
경상북도는 최근 '2026년 햇살 에너지 농사 지원사업' 선정 평가위원회를 열고, 지원 대상 농가 95곳에 79억 원을 지원하기로 했습니다.

태양광 설비 시설의 용량은 100kW까지 가능하며, 지원 한도는 최대 1억 4천만 원입니다.

상환은 6개월 거치한 뒤 11년 6개월간 원금을 분할 상환하는 방식으로 진행됩니다.

이 사업은 태양광 발전 시설을 설치하는 농가에 연 1%의 낮은 금리로 설치비를 융자 지원하는 것으로, 경북형 햇빛연금 모델로 자리 잡고 있습니다.

snippet.title: '석적 하이패스 IC' 설치 확정⋯대구까지 71분에서 54분으로 단축될 듯 #shorts (대구MBC)
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
경상북도에 따르면 칠곡군 지역 주민의 오랜 숙원사업인 '경부고속도로 석적 하이패스 IC' 신설 사업이 국토교통부로부터 최종 승인을 받았습니다.

이번 공사는 2026년 하반기부터 설계에 착수해 2030년 개통을 목표로 하며, 사업비는 148억 원으로 칠곡군과 한국도로공사가 각각 50% 부담합니다.

하이패스 전용 IC가 설치되면 대구까지 이동 시간이 71분에서 54분으로 약 17분 단축될 것으로 기대됩니다.

snippet.title: 보험금 타기 위해 식당에 불 지른 60대 징역 2년 #shorts (대구MBC)
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
대구지방법원 제13형사부 채희인 부장판사는 보험금을 타 낼 목적으로 자신이 운영하는 식당에 불을 지른 혐의로 기소된 60대 A 씨에게 징역 2년을 선고했습니다.

A씨는 2024년 12월 17일 밤 10시쯤 김천에서 자신의 식당 바닥에 인화성 물질을 뿌리고 불을 질러 1억 원 상당의 보험금을 타 내려다 미수에 그친 혐의로 재판에 넘겨졌습니다.

재판부는 피고인 희망에 따라 진행된 국민 참여 재판에서 배심원 7명이 만장일치로 유죄 평결을 내렸고, 국과수 감정 결과와 CCTV 영상 등 증거를 토대로 유죄가 인정된다고 밝혔습니다.

snippet.title: 대구시교육청, 사립유치원 학급운영비 63억 원 지원 #shorts (대구MBC)
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
대구시교육청이 학부모의 교육비 부담을 줄이고 사립유치원의 안정적인 운영을 지원하기 위해 2026년 사립유치원 학급 운영비로 총 63억 원을 지원합니다.

지원 대상은 2026년 원비 인상 상한율인 2.6%를 준수한 사립유치원 전체 173곳이며, 지원금은 상·하반기로 나눠 집행될 예정입니다.

시 교육청은 원비 평균 총액을 기준으로 지원 기준을 4개 구간으로 세분화해 학급당 최소 35만 원에서 최대 50만 원까지 차등 지원할 방침입니다.

snippet.title: 대구·경북 상장사 시가총액 155조 원 돌파···전월 대비 23.7% 급증 #shorts (대구MBC)
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
한국거래소 대구혁신성장센터에 따르면 지난 4월 대구·경북 상장법인 122개사의 시가 총액은 155조 681억 원으로 전달보다 23.7%, 29조 7,063억 원 증가했습니다.

전기·전자와 금속, 일반서비스 업종 상승 폭이 컸습니다.

시가총액 기준으로 유가 증권 시장에서는 POSCO 홀딩스가 9조 6,994억 원 증가해 가장 큰 폭의 상승을 기록했고, 코스닥 시장에서는 에스앤에스텍이 5,291억 원 늘어나며 증가액 1위를 차지했습니다.

지역 투자자의 거래대금은 9조 8,289억 원으로 전월보다 1.7% 소폭 증가한 것으로 나타났습니다.

(편집 김푸름)

snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
요즘은 안전 문제나 학부모들의 민원 등으로 아예 소풍을 가지 않는 경우도 많다고 하지만 1980년대는 그렇지 않았습니다. 한 반 학생이 60명 안팎이나 되는 시절이었지만 국민학교 근처의 산이나 공원, 유원지까지 친구들의 손을 잡고 걸어가서 보물찾기나 장기자랑, 여러 놀이를 즐겼죠. 소풍날 아침에는 어머니가 김밥을 싸고 소풍에는 학부모가 같이 가서 아이들을 같이 돌보는 경우도 흔했습니다. 같이 걷고 먹고 놀고 추억을 만드는 가족 행사의 성격도 있었던 건데요, 1989년 대구 망우공원의 국민학교 소풍 모습은 어땠을까요?

snippet.description:

대구 집값이 30개월 연속 하락했습니다.

snippet.title: 4월 대구·경북 수출 24.2억 달러 흑자···2025년보다 4.8% 늘어 #shorts (대구MBC)
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
대구 경북지역의 무역 흑자가 두 달 연속 증가했습니다.

대구본부세관이 발표한 수출입현황 자료를 보면, 지난 4월 대구·경북의 무역수지는 24억 2,000만 달러 흑자를 기록해 1년 전보다 4.8% 증가했습니다.

대구와 경북의 무역수지 흑자는 지난 2월 20억 6,000만 달러, 3월 22억 9,000만 달러에 이어 4월에는 24억 달러를 넘어서면서 두 달 연속 증가했습니다.

수출은 45억 8,000만 달러로 10.7% 늘었고, 수입은 21억 6,000만 달러로 18.8% 증가했습니다.

snippet.description:

snippet.title: 경상북도 "햇살 에너지 농사 지으세요"⋯태양광 설비에 저리 융자 지원 #shorts (대구MBC)
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
경상북도는 최근 '2026년 햇살 에너지 농사 지원사업' 선정 평가위원회를 열고, 지원 대상 농가 95곳에 79억 원을 지원하기로 했습니다.

태양광 설비 시설의 용량은 100kW까지 가능하며, 지원 한도는 최대 1억 4천만 원입니다.

상환은 6개월 거치한 뒤 11년 6개월간 원금을 분할 상환하는 방식으로 진행됩니다.

이 사업은 태양광 발전 시설을 설치하는 농가에 연 1%의 낮은 금리로 설치비를 융자 지원하는 것으로, 경북형 햇빛연금 모델로 자리 잡고 있습니다.

en-US.title: Installation of 'Seokjeok Hi-Pass IC' Confirmed... Travel Time to Daegu Expected to Be Reduced fr...
en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

According to Gyeongsangbuk-do Province, the construction of the 'Seokjeok Hi-Pass IC on the Gyeongbu Expressway,' a long-cherished wish of the residents of Chilgok-gun, has received final approval from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.

Design work for this project is scheduled to begin in the second half of 2026, with the goal of opening in 2030. The project cost is 14.8 billion won, with Chilgok-gun and the Korea Expressway Corporation each bearing 50% of the cost.

Once the dedicated Hi-Pass IC is installed, travel time to Daegu is expected to be reduced by approximately 17 minutes, from 71 minutes to 54 minutes.

(Edited by Kim Yi-seul)

Presiding Judge Chae Hee-in of the 13th Criminal Division of the Daegu District Court sentenced Mr. A, a man in his 60s, to two years in prison for setting fire to his own restaurant with the intent to collect insurance money.

Hakim Ketua Chae Hee-in dari Divisi Pidana ke-13 Pengadilan Distrik Daegu menjatuhkan hukuman dua tahun penjara kepada Bapak A, seorang pria berusia 60-an, karena membakar restorannya sendiri dengan maksud untuk mendapatkan uang asuransi.

id.title: Kantor Pendidikan Metropolitan Daegu Akan Memberikan Dukungan Sebesar 6,3 Miliar Won untuk Biaya ...
id.description:
[Berita MBC Daegu]

Kantor Pendidikan Metropolitan Daegu akan menyediakan total 6,3 miliar won untuk biaya operasional kelas TK swasta pada tahun 2026 guna mengurangi beban keuangan orang tua dan mendukung operasional TK swasta yang stabil.

Penerima dukungan ini adalah seluruh 173 TK swasta yang telah memenuhi batasan kenaikan biaya sekolah sebesar 2,6% untuk tahun 2026, dan dana tersebut dijadwalkan akan dicairkan dalam dua tahap, pada semester pertama dan kedua tahun ini.

Kantor Pendidikan berencana untuk memberikan dukungan yang berbeda-beda mulai dari minimal 350.000 won hingga maksimal 500.000 won per kelas dengan membagi kriteria dukungan menjadi empat kategori berdasarkan rata-rata total biaya sekolah.

(Disunting oleh Kim Yi-seul)

en-US.title: Daegu Metropolitan Office of Education to Provide 6.3 Billion Won in Support for Private Kinderga...
en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

The Daegu Metropolitan Office of Education will provide a total of 6.3 billion won in operating expenses for private kindergarten classes in 2026 to reduce the financial burden on parents and support the stable operation of private kindergartens.

The recipients of this support are all 173 private kindergartens that have complied with the 2.6% tuition increase cap for 2026, and the funds are scheduled to be disbursed in two installments, in the first and second halves of the year.

The Office of Education plans to provide differentiated support ranging from a minimum of 350,000 won to a maximum of 500,000 won per class by subdividing the support criteria into four brackets based on the average total tuition amount.

en-US.description:

Gyeongsangbuk-do Province announced that it has secured 19 billion won in state funding for the maintenance of the Guam and Guam 1 districts, which are steep slopes along the Ulleung Island circumferential road.

Accordingly, the province plans to invest a total of 38 billion won to commence detailed design services in the first half of 2026 and complete the project by 2028.

Once the project is completed, it is expected to prevent frequent rockfall accidents and respond to the rapidly increasing traffic demand following the opening of Ulleung Airport in 2030.

id.description:

Provinsi Gyeongsangbuk-do mengumumkan telah mengamankan dana negara sebesar 19 miliar won untuk pemeliharaan distrik Guam dan Guam 1, yang merupakan lereng curam di sepanjang jalan lingkar Pulau Ulleung.

snippet.title: 대구·경북 상장사 시가총액 155조 원 돌파···전월 대비 23.7% 급증 #shorts (대구MBC)
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
한국거래소 대구혁신성장센터에 따르면 지난 4월 대구·경북 상장법인 122개사의 시가 총액은 155조 681억 원으로 전달보다 23.7%, 29조 7,063억 원 증가했습니다.

전기·전자와 금속, 일반서비스 업종 상승 폭이 컸습니다.

시가총액 기준으로 유가 증권 시장에서는 POSCO 홀딩스가 9조 6,994억 원 증가해 가장 큰 폭의 상승을 기록했고, 코스닥 시장에서는 에스앤에스텍이 5,291억 원 늘어나며 증가액 1위를 차지했습니다.

지역 투자자의 거래대금은 9조 8,289억 원으로 전월보다 1.7% 소폭 증가한 것으로 나타났습니다.

(편집 김푸름)

id.description:
[Berita MBC Daegu]

Menurut Pusat Pertumbuhan Inovasi Bursa Efek Korea Daegu, kapitalisasi pasar dari 122 perusahaan yang terdaftar di Daegu dan Gyeongbuk pada bulan April mencapai 155,0681 triliun won, meningkat 23,7%, atau 29,7063 triliun won, dibandingkan bulan sebelumnya.

snippet.title: “엄마가 더 신나면 어떡해?” 1989년 대구의 국민학교 소풍 | 백투더투데이
snippet.description:
[대구MBC뉴스] 
요즘은 안전 문제나 학부모들의 민원 등으로 아예 소풍을 가지 않는 경우도 많다고 하지만 1980년대는 그렇지 않았습니다. 한 반 학생이 60명 안팎이나 되는 시절이었지만 국민학교 근처의 산이나 공원, 유원지까지 친구들의 손을 잡고 걸어가서 보물찾기나 장기자랑, 여러 놀이를 즐겼죠. 소풍날 아침에는 어머니가 김밥을 싸고 소풍에는 학부모가 같이 가서 아이들을 같이 돌보는 경우도 흔했습니다. 같이 걷고 먹고 놀고 추억을 만드는 가족 행사의 성격도 있었던 건데요, 1989년 대구 망우공원의 국민학교 소풍 모습은 어땠을까요?

en-US.title: “What if Mom gets even more excited?” 1989 Daegu Elementary School Picnic | Back to the Today
en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

While it is said that nowadays, many schools do not go on picnics at all due to safety concerns or complaints from parents, the 1980s were not like that. Even though it was a time when a class had around 60 students, elementary school students would walk hand in hand to nearby mountains, parks, or amusement areas to enjoy treasure hunts, talent shows, and various other games. It was common for mothers to pack gimbap on the morning of the picnic, and for parents to accompany the children to look after them. It was essentially a family event where they walked, ate, played, and created memories together. So, what was the scene like at an elementary school picnic at Mangwu Park in Daegu in 1989?

id.title: “Bagaimana jika Ibu malah semakin bersemangat?” Piknik Sekolah Dasar Daegu 1989 | Kembali ke Masa...
id.description:
[Berita MBC Daegu]

Meskipun dikatakan bahwa saat ini banyak sekolah tidak lagi mengadakan piknik karena masalah keamanan atau keluhan dari orang tua, tahun 1980-an tidaklah demikian. Sudah biasa bagi para ibu untuk menyiapkan gimbap di pagi hari piknik, dan orang tua menemani anak-anak untuk mengawasi mereka. Pada dasarnya itu adalah acara keluarga di mana mereka berjalan, makan, bermain, dan menciptakan kenangan bersama. Jadi, seperti apa suasana piknik sekolah dasar di Taman Mangwu di Daegu pada tahun 1989?

Kabupaten Cheongsong, Provinsi Gyeongsang Utara, telah memutuskan untuk menyelenggarakan Festival Apel Cheongsong 2026 selama lima hari, dari tanggal 4 hingga 8 November, di area Batu Hyeonbiam di sepanjang Sungai Yongjeon.

en-US.title: Cheongsong County, North Gyeongsang Province Confirms Cheongsong Apple Festival to be Held Novemb...
en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

Cheongsong County, North Gyeongsang Province, has decided to hold the 2026 Cheongsong Apple Festival for five days from November 4 to 8 at the Hyeonbiam Rock area along Yongjeon Stream.

Cheongsong County explained that the festival's theme is "Cheongsong Now! Colored with Apples," conveying the meaning of inviting visitors during the time when Cheongsong apples are at their most delicious.

Based on feedback from visitors to the 2025 festival, the county plans to expand facilities for the disabled and family rest areas.

광주 여고생 흉기 살해 사건과 관련해 대구경찰이 학교 통학로 합동 점검에 나섰습니다.

대구경찰청은 5월 15일 아침 정화여자고등학교 인근 통학로에서 학교, 구청 관계자와 함께 범죄 사각지대가 있는지 등을 점검했습니다.

경찰은 앞으로 10주 동안 학생들이 자주 다니는 길에서 예방순찰을 강화하고 수상한 사람을 발견하면 적극적으로 검문할 예정입니다.

또 학교와 학원가 등에서 범죄에 취약한 점을 찾아 CCTV와 보안등 등 시설물을 개선할 계획입니다.

en-US.title: Daegu Police Conduct Joint Inspection of School Routes... Strengthening Preventive Patrols #short...
en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

In connection with the stabbing murder of a female high school student in Gwangju, the Daegu Police have launched a joint inspection of school routes.

On the morning of May 15, the Daegu Metropolitan Police Agency inspected the route near Jeonghwa Girls' High School with school and district office officials to identify any blind spots for crime.

Over the next 10 weeks, the police plan to strengthen preventive patrols on paths frequently used by students and actively question anyone they spot suspicious.

They also plan to identify crime vulnerabilities in areas around schools and private academies and improve facilities such as CCTVs and security lights.

(Edited by Kim Pu-reum)

id.title: Kepolisian Daegu Melakukan Inspeksi Gabungan di Rute Sekolah... Memperkuat Patroli Pencegahan #sh...
id.description:
[Berita MBC Daegu]

Sehubungan dengan pembunuhan dengan penusukan terhadap seorang siswi SMA di Gwangju, Kepolisian Daegu telah meluncurkan inspeksi gabungan di jalur-jalur sekolah.

Pada pagi hari tanggal 15 Mei, Badan Kepolisian Metropolitan Daegu memeriksa jalur di dekat SMA Putri Jeonghwa bersama pejabat sekolah dan kantor distrik untuk mengidentifikasi titik-titik rawan kejahatan.

Selama 10 minggu ke depan, polisi berencana untuk memperkuat patroli pencegahan di jalur-jalur yang sering digunakan oleh siswa dan secara aktif menanyai siapa pun yang mereka lihat mencurigakan.

Mereka juga berencana untuk mengidentifikasi kerentanan kejahatan di area sekitar sekolah dan akademi swasta serta meningkatkan fasilitas seperti CCTV dan lampu keamanan.

en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

The trade surplus in the Daegu and Gyeongbuk region has increased for two consecutive months.

According to import and export data released by the Daegu Customs Headquarters, the trade balance for Daegu and Gyeongbuk recorded a surplus of $2.42 billion last April, a 4.8% increase compared to a year ago.

Following $2.06 billion in February and $2.29 billion in March, the trade surplus for Daegu and Gyeongbuk surpassed $2.4 billion in April, marking an increase for two consecutive months.

Exports rose by 10.7% to $4.58 billion, while imports increased by 18.8% to $2.16 billion.

snippet.description:

en-US.title: Once Upon a Time in Daegu - May 1980 #BackToTheToday
en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

In May 1980, Gwangju became the spark of our country's democratization movement through the resistance and sacrifice of countless citizens. Although the situation in Gwangju was not effectively conveyed to other regions due to strict media control, resistance spread significantly in other areas as well, centered around university districts and downtown areas. The situation in Daegu, now known as the "Heart of Conservatism," was not much different. Around May 14, 1980, protests demanding the "abolition of martial law," the "resignation of Chun Doo-hwan," and the "guarantee of freedom of the press" took place, and the conflict reached its peak as the police and military physically suppressed them. Keimyung University even issued a school closure order on May 15, the first in the nation. However, news of these events did not properly reach a significant number of ordinary citizens, and a large-scale athletic meet was held at Daegu Citizens' Stadium on May 18. What was Daegu like in May 1980?

#BackToTheToday #1980 #May #DaeguMBC

id.title: Dahulu Kala di Daegu - Mei 1980 | Kembali ke Masa Kini
id.description:
[Berita MBC Daegu]

Pada Mei 1980, Gwangju menjadi pemicu gerakan demokratisasi negara kita melalui perlawanan dan pengorbanan warga yang tak terhitung jumlahnya. Meskipun situasi di Gwangju tidak tersampaikan secara efektif ke daerah lain karena kontrol media yang ketat, perlawanan menyebar secara signifikan di daerah lain juga, berpusat di sekitar distrik universitas dan daerah pusat kota. Situasi di Daegu, yang sekarang dikenal sebagai "Jantung Konservatisme," tidak jauh berbeda. Sekitar tanggal 14 Mei 1980, protes menuntut "penghapusan darurat militer," "pengunduran diri Chun Doo-hwan," dan "jaminan kebebasan pers" terjadi, dan konflik mencapai puncaknya ketika polisi dan militer secara fisik menindas mereka. Universitas Keimyung bahkan mengeluarkan perintah penutupan sekolah pada tanggal 15 Mei, yang pertama di negara ini. Namun, berita tentang peristiwa ini tidak sampai ke sejumlah besar warga biasa, dan sebuah acara atletik besar diadakan di Stadion Warga Daegu pada tanggal 18 Mei. Seperti apa Daegu pada Mei 1980?

#KembaliKeHariIni #1980 #Mei #DaeguMBC

en-US.title: Once Upon a Time in Daegu - May 1980 | Back to the Today
en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

In May 1980, Gwangju became the spark of our country's democratization movement through the resistance and sacrifice of countless citizens. Although the situation in Gwangju was not effectively conveyed to other regions due to strict media control, resistance spread significantly in other areas as well, centered around university districts and downtown areas. The situation in Daegu, now known as the "Heart of Conservatism," was not much different. Around May 14, 1980, protests demanding the "abolition of martial law," the "resignation of Chun Doo-hwan," and the "guarantee of freedom of the press" took place, and the conflict reached its peak as the police and military physically suppressed them. Keimyung University even issued a school closure order on May 15, the first in the nation. However, news of these events did not properly reach a significant number of ordinary citizens, and a large-scale athletic meet was held at Daegu Citizens' Stadium on May 18. What was Daegu like in May 1980?

#BackToTheToday #1980 #May #DaeguMBC

en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

Ordinances are the most fundamental institutions of local government and are equivalent to laws in the national context.

Ordinances inevitably have a significant impact on the lives of residents. However, it has been pointed out that in Daegu in particular, the implementation of ordinances is frequently delayed,

or there are many cases where they are not introduced at all.

Therefore, Daegu's civil society has proposed that candidates running in the local elections select excellent ordinances from across the country and adopt them as core policies.

(Edited by Lee Seung-yoon)

id.title: “Hanya Daegu yang belum ada” “Daegu adalah yang terbaru” “Peraturan yang bagus harus diadopsi ke ...
id.description:
[Berita MBC Daegu]

Peraturan daerah merupakan lembaga paling mendasar dalam pemerintahan lokal dan setara dengan undang-undang dalam konteks nasional.

Peraturan daerah pasti berdampak signifikan pada kehidupan warga. Namun, telah diketahui bahwa di Daegu khususnya, implementasi peraturan daerah seringkali tertunda,

atau bahkan banyak kasus di mana peraturan daerah sama sekali tidak diterapkan.

Oleh karena itu, masyarakat sipil Daegu mengusulkan agar calon yang maju dalam pemilihan lokal memilih peraturan daerah yang unggul dari seluruh negeri dan mengadopsinya sebagai kebijakan inti.

(Disunting oleh Lee Seung-yoon)

en-US.title: Midsummer heat during the day on the weekend... Beware of temperature fluctuations #shorts (Daegu...
en-US.description:
[Daegu MBC News]

The Daegu and Gyeongbuk regions experienced clear and hot weather on May 15.

On May 15, daytime highs reached 29.4 degrees in Daegu, 30.8 degrees in Gumi, and 30.7 degrees in Andong.

Clear and hot weather is expected to continue through the weekend.

On Saturday, morning lows in Daegu will range from 10 to 16 degrees, including 13 degrees, while daytime highs will soar from 24 to 33 degrees, with Daegu reaching 33 degrees.

The Daegu Regional Meteorological Office forecasted that daytime temperatures in Daegu will rise to 34 degrees on Sunday as well, predicting that it will remain hot during the day for the time being. (Edited by Kim Pu-reum)

id.title: Panas terik siang hari di akhir pekan... Waspadai fluktuasi suhu #celanapendek (Daegu MBC)
id.description:
[Berita MBC Daegu]

Wilayah Daegu dan Gyeongbuk mengalami cuaca cerah dan panas pada tanggal 15 Mei.

Pada tanggal 15 Mei, suhu tertinggi siang hari mencapai 29,4 derajat di Daegu, 30,8 derajat di Gumi, dan 30,7 derajat di Andong.

Cuaca cerah dan panas diperkirakan akan berlanjut hingga akhir pekan.

Pada hari Sabtu, suhu terendah pagi hari di Daegu akan berkisar antara 10 hingga 16 derajat, termasuk 13 derajat, sementara suhu tertinggi siang hari akan melonjak dari 24 hingga 33 derajat, dengan Daegu mencapai 33 derajat.

Kantor Meteorologi Regional Daegu memperkirakan bahwa suhu siang hari di Daegu akan naik hingga 34 derajat pada hari Minggu juga, memprediksi bahwa cuaca akan tetap panas sepanjang hari untuk sementara waktu. (Disunting oleh Kim Pu-reum)

#CuacaDaegu #CuacaGyeongbuk #Panas #BeritaMBCDaegu
